image: Bandeira do estado do Rio de Janeiro.svg
name: Rio de Janeiro
summary: Quartered in white and blue, with the state arms in the centre: an eagle above a shield with a mountain landscape, framed by sugarcane and coffee branches.
origin: The flag was set by State Law No. 5588 of 5 October 1965 and kept unchanged after the merger with Guanabara in 1975.

symbols.name: Eagle
symbols.description: A golden eagle above the shield.

facts: The city of Rio was Brazil's capital from 1763 to 1960.
The state of Guanabara merged into Rio de Janeiro in 1975.
clues: White and blue quarters with an eagle and a shield.
The state of Brazil's former capital.
